environment.description: Deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as a systemd service under the 'appuser' account. The container runs with default capabilities. Flask app served via gunicorn behind an nginx reverse proxy with basic TLS termination. No additional request filtering or sandboxing. The appuser has standard shell access and the instance has an IAM role with S3 and SSM permissions for deployment purposes.

config.proxy: nginx 1.20 with proxy_pass, no ModSecurity, no request body inspection
config.network: outbound unrestricted, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
